# smoothstate

> Fast smoothing of state probabilities for Polars workflows

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Binary state smoothing

- [smooth_binary_state](https://uriahf.github.io/smoothstate/reference/smooth_binary_state.html): Smooth ``P(state=1 | prob)`` with local linear regression

#### Time-dependent state smoothing

- [smooth_state_cox](https://uriahf.github.io/smoothstate/reference/smooth_state_cox.html): Smooth event-state probability using secondary Cox + 3-knot RCS
